The "both undefined vs" variant is unreachable (updateNetworkView always adds a style per subnetwork) and moot (undefined vs means getMapping yields no mapping to lose). The reviewer's separate point that mechanically adding filterConfigs to deps would loop is fair advice, but the asserted present-day staleness bug does not hold up.
